# CampusFlow Lite

> Academic Consideration, OD Clearances & Student Leave Management System for Oriental Institute of Science & Technology (OIST).

## System Modules & Routes
- [Tutor Guardian Workspace](http://localhost:5173/tg)
- [HOD Administration Portal](http://localhost:5173/hod/dashboard)
- [Student Application Dashboard](http://localhost:5173/student/dashboard)
- [Faculty / Teacher Portal](http://localhost:5173/teacher/dashboard)
- [Institutional Documentation](http://localhost:5173/)
